shortDescription: Gathers information about PowerStore Storage entities

options.name: all_pages
options.description: Indicates whether to return all available entities on the storage system. If set to C(true), the Info module will implement pagination and return all entities. Otherwise, a maximum of the first 100 entities of any type will be returned.

options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: filters
options.description: A list of filters to support filtered output for storage entities. Each filter is a list of I(filter_key), I(filter_operator), I(filter_value). Supports passing of multiple filters.

options.name: gather_subset
options.description: A list of string variables which specify the PowerStore system entities requiring information. Volumes - C(vol). All the nodes - C(node). Volume groups - C(vg). Protection policies - C(protection_policy). Hosts - C(host). Host groups - C(hg). Snapshot rules - C(snapshot_rule). NAS servers - C(nas_server). NFS exports - C(nfs_export). SMB shares - C(smb_share). Tree quotas - C(tree_quota). User quotas - C(user_quota). File systems - C(file_system). Replication rules - C(replication_rule). Replica

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
